rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that provides help or support, especially in technical or institutional contexts.

example.english: This auxiliary system can help you find information quickly.
example.traditional: 呢個輔助嘅系統可以幫你快速搵資料。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fu6 zo6 ge3 hai6 tung2 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 faai3 cuk1 wan2 zi1 liu6

rows.note: Use this when the auxiliary item is an extra addition beyond what is normally provided.

example.english: The company provides auxiliary training for new employees.
example.traditional: 公司會提供額外嘅培訓俾新員工。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 wui5 tai4 gung1 ngaak6 ngoi6 ge3 pui4 fan3 bei2 san1 jyun4 gung1

rows.note: Use this for the subsidiary or attached aspect of something, rather than merely an extra item.

example.english: This hospital has an auxiliary research centre.
example.traditional: 呢間醫院有一個附屬嘅研究中心。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 ji1 jyun2 jau5 jat1 go3 fu6 suk6 ge3 jin4 gau3 zung1 sam1

rows.note: Use this when something is kept ready as a reserve or backup.

example.english: We kept an auxiliary computer in reserve in case the main one broke down.
example.traditional: 我哋留咗部後備嘅電腦，以防主機壞咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 lau4 zo2 bou6 hau6 bei6 ge3 din6 nou5 ji5 fong4 zyu2 gei1 waai6 zo2
